_comment: Gate Escape (p01) — curated ad/creative moments. Every entry is REAL gameplay reachable by any player at the stated level; tools/capture.mjs plays each recipe through the shipped engine with real pointer gestures and records stills + a short webm into prototypes/p01-gate-escape/marketing/. ASA 'core experience' compliance: nothing shown here is staged, sped up, or exclusive to the capture build — the honest-claim note on each moment says where it lives in the game.

moments.film: Title block → Play → the red block dragged straight out through its gate in one gesture: gate flash, particles, the 3-star win card.
recipe: pointer-drag block 0 along solutions[0] (one drag, out the right gate)
hold on the win card through the star drop
moments.honest_claim: Level 1 exactly as every new player sees it; the ghost route on the board is the built-in L1 teaching overlay, shown to everyone.

moments.film: The first deadlock level played into the ground: budget burned, the 'So close!' sheet slides up with the board fitted above it and the one-drag-from-freedom ghost route pulsing, then the rescue: AD placeholder → +3 lands green on the counter.
recipe: seed L1–5 cleared (ge_prog {u:5, s:[3,3,3,3,3]}), start level 6
burn the 9-move budget with legal non-solving one-cell drags
fail sheet up → tap #btnRescue → ad placeholder completes → +3 moves
play the solver's reference moves with the rescued budget
moments.console: GE.load(5); shuffle any block until movesLeft is 0; btnRescue
moments.honest_claim: Level 6 is the first level whose par exceeds its block count; every player who runs out of moves sees exactly this sheet, route and rescue (rescue is once per attempt).

moments.film: A corked mid-game board, 6 blocks and stones; the HUD hint (AD ?) tapped: ad placeholder → the designer's reference move ghosts across the board as a marching dashed route with a travelling finger pip.
recipe: seed L1–9 cleared (ge_prog {u:9, s:[3×9]}, ge_level 9), start level 10
ad placeholder completes → ghost route / parking outline renders
hold ~4 s while the route pulses
moments.honest_claim: Level 10 is the game's second deadlock board; the hint is available on every level from the HUD (one per board position, rewarded slot).

moments.film: A par (3-star) clear of level 8 that carries Sheet 1 across 24★: stars drop with the spark burst, then the chest row pops — lid swings open, sparks, chime — naming the Sepia draft paper with its Try it button.
recipe: seed L1–7 at 3★ (21★, chest at 24★ needs this win), start level 8
hold through stars → chest reveal → Try it
moments.console: seed ge_prog {u:29, s:[3,3,3,3,3,3,3]}; GE.load(7); play solutions[7]
moments.honest_claim: Chests open at 24 of a sheet's 30 stars and reward a cosmetic paper skin only; nothing is gated on them. Any player crossing 24★ on Sheet 1 sees exactly this reveal.
